externalHelp: The value comes from an external source (file or environment variable, set in the configuration file). “Take over into Tapesmith” stores it in Windows Credential Manager.
removeConfirmMessage: The stored value is deleted from Windows Credential Manager. The service only works again once a new value is saved.
removeConfirmExternal: The reference to the external source is removed. The file or environment variable itself stays unchanged.
adoptAria: Take over value for {{name}} into Tapesmith
externalEmpty: External source empty: enter the value directly
